settings.heading: Terms of Service
settings.content:
Last updated: January 2025

These Terms of Service govern your use of our art commission services and digital products. By placing an order or commissioning work from us, you agree to be bound by these terms.

1. General Terms

By accessing our website and purchasing our digital art products or commission services, you represent that you are at least 18 years old or have parental consent. We reserve the right to refuse service to anyone for any reason at any time.

2. Digital Products

All digital products, including Shopify templates, art prints, and downloadable files, are delivered electronically. Upon successful payment, you will receive access to download your purchased files. Digital products are non-refundable once downloaded.

3. Commission Services

3.1 Booking: A commission is considered booked only after full payment or agreed-upon deposit has been received. We reserve the right to decline or cancel commissions at our discretion.

3.2 Timeline: Estimated delivery times are provided as guidelines only. Complex works may take longer. We will communicate any delays promptly.

3.3 Revisions: Each commission includes revisions as specified in your chosen package. Additional revisions may incur extra charges. Revision requests must be submitted within 7 days of receiving the initial draft.

4. Payment Terms

Full payment is required before work begins unless otherwise agreed upon. We accept major credit cards, PayPal, and other payment methods as displayed at checkout. All prices are in USD unless otherwise stated.

4.1 Deposits: For commissions over $100, a 50% non-refundable deposit is required to secure your slot. The remaining balance is due upon completion before final delivery.

4.2 Late Payments: If payment is not received within 7 days of the invoice date, we reserve the right to cancel your commission without refund.

5. Usage Rights & Licensing

5.1 Personal Use: Upon full payment, you receive a non-exclusive license to use the artwork for personal, non-commercial purposes including social media profiles, personal websites, and printing for personal use.

5.2 Commercial Use: Commercial usage rights (for merchandise, advertising, branding, etc.) must be purchased as an add-on. Without commercial license, you may not use the artwork for any revenue-generating purposes.

5.3 Portfolio Rights: We reserve the right to display completed commissions in our portfolio, social media, and website unless you explicitly request otherwise in writing before the project begins.

6. Refund Policy

6.1 Digital Products: Due to the nature of digital products, all sales are final once the file has been downloaded. If you encounter technical issues, please contact us within 48 hours of purchase.

6.2 Commissions: Refunds for commissions are handled on a case-by-case basis. If work has not yet begun, a full refund minus the deposit may be issued. If work is in progress, refunds will be prorated based on completion.

7. Cancellation Policy

You may cancel your commission at any time before work begins for a full refund (excluding deposit). Once work has started, cancellation fees apply based on the amount of work completed. We reserve the right to cancel commissions at any time with a full refund of any payments made.

8. Intellectual Property

All artwork remains the intellectual property of the artist until full payment is received. Upon full payment, you receive the usage rights as specified in Section 5. You may not claim the artwork as your own creation, alter the artwork without permission, or redistribute the original files.

9. Limitation of Liability

We shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of our services or products. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid for the specific service or product in question.

10. Privacy

Your personal information will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties without your consent.

11. Changes to Terms

We reserve the right to update these Terms of Service at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting on this page. Your continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

12. Contact

If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us through our contact page or email us at hello@example.com.
